name: Cetyl caprylate
description: Cetyl caprylate (CAS 29710-31-4 ), also known as hexadecyl octanoate, is a synthetic ester derived from cetyl alcohol and caprylic acid. It functions as an emollient, skin-conditioning agent, and lubricant across personal care and industrial formulations. Buyers source it primarily for its light skin feel and compatibility with a broad range of cosmetic and technical bases. In skincare and color cosmetics, it imparts a dry, non-greasy skin feel to creams, lotions, and foundations. This ester is highly valued for improving spreadability in various topical applications. Sun care and lip care formulators use it as an emollient carrier that enhances texture without contributing heaviness or occlusion. In industrial lubricant formulations, it provides a stable, low-viscosity base component suitable for metalworking fluids and release agents. This versatility makes it a staple for manufacturers seeking reliable performance. Coatings and sealant manufacturers incorporate it to improve substrate wetting and surface slip in finished products. Its chemical stability ensures consistent results across diverse manufacturing environments and temperature ranges. The material is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid at ambient temperatures. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the differing purity requirements of various users. Standard packaging includes drums and intermediate bulk containers for efficient logistics.
